html:
Nicolae Ceaușescu was the communist leader of Romania from 1965 to 1989, born in 1918 in the village of Scornicești, who built a personality cult and starved his country to pay off its debts.

At first he was praised in the West for defying Moscow, condemning the invasion of Czechoslovakia in 1968. After visiting China and North Korea in 1971 he copied their mass cult of the leader. His wife Elena held power with him. He banned abortion with Decree 770, and in the 1980s he cut food, heat and power to repay foreign debt, while tearing down a large part of old Bucharest to build the huge Palace of the Parliament. The secret police, the Securitate, spied on millions. He fled during the revolution and was shot with Elena on 25 December 1989 after a brief trial.
sum: Nicolae Ceaușescu was the communist leader of Romania from 1965 to 1989, born in 1918 in the village of Scornicești, who built a personality cult and starved his country to pay off its debts.
